equity.level_reason: Results by race/ethnicity and household food sufficiency are reported and described (highest among Black children; less likely with low food sufficiency), but only as side-by-side values with chi-square significance, no computed difference or ratio and no disparity framing.

level_alternative.reason: Food sufficiency is an HRSN measure used as stratifier, so contrasts across it could meet level 3 without the word disparity if 'less likely/more likely' were read as quantified.
